procedural_matters: MNE 74 is represented by Nikola Matijevic.
Katarina Prica (SRB 235) gave evidence as a witness for MNE 74.
The hearing is held under RRS 63.1 (b)
The panel of the IJ was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b)
facts: The conditions in race 8 were 5-6 knots with very little waves.
MNE 74 on port entered the zone of the starboard mark at the gate inside overlapped of CHI 213 sailing on starboard.
The distance between CHI and the mark was less than a boats width.
conclusions: CHI 213 outside overlapped at the zone failed to give MNE 74 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(1).
MNE 74 touched the starboard gate mark and broke RRS 31.
Since MNE 74 broke RRS 31 while she was sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(b) for this breach.

It was not reasonably possible for MNE 74 the boat sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled to avoid contact with CHI 213 when it became clear that CHI 213 was not giving mark-room. MNE 74 did not break RRS 14(a).
CHI 213 did not avoid contact with MNE 74 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
